controls.label: Shape
controls.title: Original stereophotogrammetric reconstruction archived by NASA PDS/NAIF, at its published kilometer scale. The shared grid marks unavailable imagery. This is source geometry, not a photographic surface or reflectance map. Lucy stereo images constrain about 40% of the surface. The source authors completed the unseen part using a two-ellipsoid fit and symmetry; it is not all observed terrain. The body tumbles, and the preliminary frame is accurate only near the 2025 encounter. This display uses a fixed illustrative orientation and does not propagate that attitude. No registered optical surface map is supplied. Lighting is illustrative in a fixed model frame.
